issues.description: The template's Main.java contains commented example instantiations of Seal, Pig, and Goat using two constructor parameters (e.g. Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")), while the UML in the problem statement and the solution implementation define Animal and the animal subclasses with a single-argument constructor that only initializes the name. This mismatch between the template's example usage and the specification/solution may confuse students about which constructor signature they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor usage consistent across artifacts. Either update the commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java (template) to use single-argument constructors (e.g. Seal("Clarabelle"), Pig("Doodle"), Goat("Buttinsky")), or if a second attribute was intended, update the UML/problem statement and the solution to include and initialize that additional attribute in the Animal/child constructors. The simplest fix is to change the template Main.java commented instantiations to single-argument constructors to match the specification and solution.
